_source: Definitions are frozen in the harnesses; this file restates them so a reproducer does not have to read code to know what was mutated.

anchor_rule.meaning: a decimal, or an integer of at least 2 digits; single digits never anchor
anchor_rule.consequence: single-digit quantitative claims are unreachable by construction -- a known, reported sensitivity limit, not a bug.

numeric_perturbation.definition: replace one result number with a different one GUARANTEED absent from every chunk of that paper (up to 40 candidate draws)

paraphrase_rule.definition: deterministic synonym / voice / clause-order rewrite of a result SENTENCE; kept only if it preserves every number and every metric token

paraphrase_llm.definition: qwen2.5:7b paraphrase at seed 42 instructed to keep every number and metric name; guarded by a post-hoc check that the numbers survived
paraphrase_llm.determinism: APPROXIMATE -- this class is the LLM-dependent part of Matrix C

fabrication.definition: a synthetic OWN-claim sentence asserting a metric value absent from the paper

support_deletion_primary.definition: remove the single chunk that primarily grounds the claim
support_deletion_primary.known_weakness: the value often recurs in another chunk, so both the gate (11/24) and the evaluation framework (2/24) mostly fail to flag it

support_deletion_full.definition: remove EVERY chunk containing any of the claim's numbers

cross_row_structural.definition: bind row A's label plus a real column-metric token to row B's number, from a genuine multi-row result-table chunk
cross_row_structural.control_required: see the positive control in Table 3 -- the raw detection rate is not interpretable without it

adversarial_binding_probe_classes.correct_row_wrong_col: the subject's own row, but the value taken from a different column
adversarial_binding_probe_classes.correct_col_wrong_row: the claimed metric's column, but the value taken from a different row (cross-row)
adversarial_binding_probe_classes.correct_metric_wrong_condition: the right metric, attributed to a different experimental condition/row
adversarial_binding_probe_classes.cross_table_substitution: a numeric value lifted from a different table in the same paper
adversarial_binding_probe_classes.positive_control: correct_cell -- the subject's own row AND column; must be RETURNED for the adversarial results to mean anything
adversarial_binding_probe_classes.acceptance_definition: an adversarial probe is ACCEPTED iff its FINAL outcome is RETURNED, regardless of which internal binding route produced it (invariant 16)

criterion_J.statement: a parity-gate fallback is JUSTIFIED iff pdf_survival(all) > latex_survival(all)
criterion_J.otherwise: OVER-TRIGGERED -- the aggregate tied or favoured LaTeX and a sub-split fired alone
criterion_J.rationale: derived from the rule latex_parity.py states: every numeric value the PDF path preserves must also survive the LaTeX path
criterion_J.pre_registration_is_verifiable: that commit contains the criterion and NO measurement; the numbers landed in the following commit
criterion_J.descriptive_not_criterion: the absolute occurrence deficit is reported alongside to expose conservatism; no case is reclassified on it
